findings.title: Cross-registry cue collision shadows validated character audio entry
findings.repro: Add finish_gabar_unarmed to base manifest or combat_polish, pointing at existing legacy finish_unarmed.wav. Character own manifest remains valid; merge(character_sfx) default overwrite=false preserves conflicting existing entry. Profile returns finish_gabar_unarmed; play_cue reads old registry entry. Actual current shipped registries have no collision.
findings.impact: Validated actor/category route may play an unreviewed/wrong file or bus/gain from a different registry.
findings.required_fix: Reject duplicate cue keys across registries before startup, or implement explicit strict policy validating final authoritative binding; add isolated startup negative and keep real currentpositive.

findings.title: Exact signal-accepted WAV/approval chain not enforced by WIP routing validator
findings.facts: Validator ignores source_sha256/decisionSHA/recipeSHA. Startup requires ResourceLoader.exists, WAV, loop disabled, duration only. Current20 copied WAV independently exactly match signal-reviewed bytes, so no actual corruption found. Runtime code does not yet prove imported PCM binding.
findings.required_closure: Strict pre-build/CI verifier anchored to accepted signal freeze and exact current20 +retained5, plus actual imported stream/cue/playback evidence and changed-WAV/coherent-manifest negative. Runtime raw source SHA reading is optional if export excludes sources.
